# 13th Pencil

> 13th Pencil is a creative and innovation company working across brand and strategy, creative, AI and innovation, experiences and digital growth. We start where the obvious answer stops.

- [Our Approach](https://13thpencil.com/about/our-approach): How a project moves past the first workable version.
- [Brand & Strategy](https://13thpencil.com/capabilities/brand-and-strategy): Positioning, brand architecture, naming, messaging, and cultural insight.
- [Start a project](https://13thpencil.com/start-a-project): The brief form for a new enquiry.
